executiveSummary.headline: Protect Information Accuracy While Closing a Significant AI Visibility Gap
executiveSummary.lead: Wyndham San Diego Bayside has a material visibility gap in the monitored AI answers, despite ranking first in its relevant Wyndham Rewards peer group. The immediate priority is accurate, controlled presentation of the hotel’s urban, bayside, business and meetings proposition—not an assumption that visibility changes will cause revenue.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: Metrics describe presence in monitored AI answers—not booking conversion, traveler exposure or revenue impact.

themes.title: Measured AI Presence
themes.what: 13.6% AI consideration and 34.8% scenario presence; #1 of 5 in the defined relevant portfolio set.
themes.whyItMatters: These are certified presence measures, not booking conversion or revenue attribution.

themes.title: Accuracy and Information Control
themes.what: ADP measured 13.6% AI consideration and 34.8% scenario presence. Business district location was recognized in 7.7% of tested observations; large ballroom in 6.6%; on-site restaurant, convention-center proximity, airport adjacency and walkable downtown were not recognized in the tested set.
themes.whyItMatters: Validate hotel facts first, then align official and partner content around a controlled source of truth.

themes.title: Technical and Commercial Follow-Through
themes.what: Automated GET, HEAD, robots.txt and sitemap requests returned HTTP 403 through Cloudflare on 2026-11-05. Because robots.txt could not be retrieved in this probe, crawler intent remains unverified.
themes.whyItMatters: Investigate technical signals cautiously and pursue commercial content only after a hotel go/no-go decision.

actions.headline: Validate and Strengthen the Urban Business and Meetings Fact Set
actions.priorityWhy: ADP found low recognition of business-district location and large-ballroom attributes within a low-consideration baseline.
actions.whatWeFound: Business district location was recognized in 7.7% of tested observations and large ballroom in 6.6%; convention-center proximity and walkable downtown were not recognized in the tested set.
actions.whyItMatters: Accurate, consistent business and meetings facts can improve the information available to AI systems and planners. This is a visibility and accuracy action, not a revenue forecast.
recommendedSteps: Hotel validates location, ballroom, meeting-capacity and transport facts.
Agency maps the approved facts across the official site and priority listings.
Add or refine clearly labeled business and meetings copy only where the approved facts support it.
Archive before-and-after pages and recheck in a future governed measurement period.
actions.supportingParties: Sales team; digital marketing agency; meetings team
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Fact validation in 2 weeks; approved updates in 30–45 days

actions.headline: Investigate Cloudflare Access for Intended Crawlers
actions.priorityWhy: The bounded research probe received Cloudflare 403 responses across the homepage and discovery files.
actions.whatWeFound: Automated GET, HEAD, robots.txt and sitemap requests returned HTTP 403; this is not proof that all search or AI crawlers are blocked.
actions.whyItMatters: If intended crawlers cannot reliably reach official content, systems may depend more heavily on secondary sources. Any security change must preserve site protection.
recommendedSteps: Agency opens a CDN review ticket with the probe timestamp and status pattern.
Confirm the intended robots.txt policy from an approved environment.
Compare WAF rules with intended crawler access.
Make no production rule change without hotel approval; retest after any approved change.

claimTypeGuide: VERIFIED_ISSUE — confirmed by certified ADP measurement or directly observed evidence.
